title: Consensus accelerates research with GPT-5 and Responses API
summary: Consensus uses GPT-5 and OpenAI’s Responses API to power a multi-agent research assistant that reads, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence in minutes—helping over 8 million researchers accelerate scientific discovery.
body: Consensus uses GPT-5 and OpenAI’s Responses API to power a multi-agent research assistant that reads, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence in minutes—helping over 8 million researchers accelerate scientific discovery.
summaryZh: 科研检索平台Consensus宣布结合GPT-5模型与OpenAI的Responses API，打造出多智能体科研助手。该系统能在几分钟内阅读、分析并综合学术证据，目前已帮助超过800万名研究人员加速科学发现。该案例展示了最新旗舰大模型与专用API在复杂多智能体工作流及科研智能化中的实际落地应用。
